answer: Willow Reputation Escrow: each identity posts a refundable deposit plus a small nonrefundable minting fee, and every action carries a capped reward tied to verified history. Cloning forces an attacker to fund many deposits and fees while fresh clones earn near-zero rewards, so honest participation stays cheaper than mass minting. A walnut-sized audit budget samples clone clusters and slashes deposits, raising the wander cost per fake identity.
